code: The client processes the incoming handshake messages and advances through client-side state transitions
note: Malformed handshake data influences certificate and key handling during client setup.

code: SSL_do_handshake dispatches into the client handshake implementation

code: For FFDHE groups the code allocates a DH object and assigns it into an EVP_PKEY

code: If EVP_PKEY_assign fails, the error path calls DH_free(dh) before jumping to cleanup

code: DH_free decrements the reference count and destroys the DH object when it reaches zero
note: The object becomes freed, setting up the use-after-free condition if another reference is retained.

code: Connection teardown later drops remaining references during SSL cleanup

code: A second DH_free reaches CRYPTO_DOWN_REF on an already freed object and writes through the stale pointer
